build_VideoTransform: build a VideoTransform to sample frames, resize, and normalize video tensors for encoding
test_VideoTransform_call: test the VideoTransform call method to verify output shape and normalized mean values
test_VideoTransform_wrong_channels: test the VideoTransform raises ValueError when input video has fewer than 3 channels
test_VideoTransform_sample_frames: test the VideoTransform sample_frames method to verify temporal frame sampling output shape
test_VideoTransform_resize_hw: test the VideoTransform resize_hw method to verify spatial resizing of video frames
